describes: `409` · `RECEIPT_NOT_READY`. `getOrderReceipt` before the order reaches COMPLETED: the receipt is written once at COMPLETED (docs/spec/01-platform.md, "P-10 — Fee breakdown presented to the customer"). The customer app shows the receipt as not ready yet rather than as an error; an order that never captured never gets one.

error.message: This order does not have a receipt yet.
